privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Security semantics of tainted context need explicit owner approval
title: A failed misato.context read is no longer indistinguishable from an empty conversation
goal: src/runtime-chat.ts reports a failed misato.context read instead of swallowing it (.catch(() => [])), so it cannot pass for "no earlier exchange"
acceptance: A failing context read is recorded or surfaced, with a test that fails without the change; an empty conversation behaves as before

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27: one catch handler and one test. Not a measurement.
